description: This file defines a static class 'PsMsgs' containing message strings and methods for error and status messages used within the PDFsharp library, specifically for internal messaging related to PDF processing, graphics, and font handling.

classes.name: PsMsgs
classes.description: A static class providing message strings and methods for internal PDFsharp library messages, including general, graphics, and PDF-specific messages.

methods.name: ListEnumCurrentOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an enumeration is out of range.

methods.name: PageIndexOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a page index is out of range.

methods.name: OutlineIndexOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an outline index is out of range.

methods.name: SetValueMustNotBeNull
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a set value property must not be null.

methods.name: InvalidValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted message indicating a value is invalid within specified bounds.

methods.name: ObsoleteFunctionCalled
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an obsolete function was called.

methods.name: OwningDocumentRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a PDF object must belong to a document.

methods.name: FileNotFound
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a specified file does not exist.

methods.name: FontDataReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a message indicating font data is read-only.

methods.name: ErrorReadingFontData
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an error occurred while parsing font data.

methods.name: PointArrayEmpty
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a PointF array must not be empty.

methods.name: PointArrayAtLeast
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a point array must contain at least a specified number of points.

methods.name: NeedPenOrBrush
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a pen or brush must be provided.

methods.name: CannotChangeImmutableObject
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an immutable object cannot be changed.

methods.name: FontAlreadyAdded
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a font face with the given name has already been added.

methods.name: NotImplementedForFontsRetrievedWithFontResolver
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a feature is not implemented for fonts retrieved with font resolver.

methods.name: InvalidPdf
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a file is not a valid PDF.

methods.name: InvalidVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a version number is invalid.

methods.name: PasswordRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a password is required to open a PDF.

methods.name: InvalidPassword
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an invalid password.

methods.name: OwnerPasswordRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an owner password is required to modify the document.

methods.name: UserOrOwnerPasswordRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that at least a user or owner password is required for encryption.

methods.name: CannotModify
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the document cannot be modified.

methods.name: NameMustStartWithSlash
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a PDF name must start with a slash.

methods.name: ImportPageNumberOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a page number is out of range for import.

methods.name: StreamMustBeWritable
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a stream does not allow writing.

methods.name: MultiplePageInsert
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a page cannot be added because it is already owned.

methods.name: UnexpectedTokenInPdfFile
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an unexpected token in a PDF file.

methods.name: InappropriateColorSpace
methods.description: Returns a message about color space mismatch based on color mode and color space.

methods.name: CannotGetGlyphTypeface
methods.description: Returns a message indicating failure to get a glyph typeface for a font.

methods.name: UnexpectedToken
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an unexpected token was encountered in parsing.
